title: Billing Office Calculation Sheet: Switch Charge for Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
The switch into the Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual under Delivery & Pickup Services is charged the annual switch price, $48.00, less a recent-fees credit of 50 percent of the order fees charged on the plan in the month up to the switch date net of the refunds booked on the plan in that month, that net amount never below zero, rounded to the cent.

## Quantities

1. **Annual switch price.** $48.00.
2. **Order fees in the month.** The order fees charged on the plan in the month up to the switch date, as the plan's charge ledger shows them.
3. **Refunds in the month.** The refunds booked on the plan in that same month.
4. **Net recent fees.** The order fees in the month less the refunds in the month; where the refunds are the larger, the net amount is zero.
5. **Recent-fees credit.** 50 percent of the net recent fees, rounded to the cent.
6. **Switch charge.** The annual switch price less the recent-fees credit, never below zero, rounded to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical ledgers for the month up to the switch date)

| Order fees charged | Refunds booked | Net recent fees | Recent-fees credit (50 percent) | Switch charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $7.99, $12.99 and $2.99, total $23.97 | $7.99 | $15.98 | $7.99 | 48.00 less 7.99 is $40.01 |
| $6.99 and $2.99, total $9.98 | none | $9.98 | $4.99 | 48.00 less 4.99 is $43.01 |
| $4.99 | $12.99 | zero (refunds are larger) | $0.00 | $48.00 |
| none | none | zero | $0.00 | $48.00 |

A refund booked in the month counts in the month whether the fee it returns was charged in that month or earlier, since the net amount compares the fees charged and the refunds booked in the same month.
